footer_stop: You do not want these emails? Stop them here: {url}
told_now_subject: {sender} has named you as the recipient of a sealed letter
told_now_text: {sender} has named you as the recipient of a sealed letter. Nothing to do now. If the letter is ever released you will get an email with a link. Please confirm that this address may receive it.
owner_confirm_subject: Confirm your email address for dead-man-switch
owner_confirm_text: This address was entered as the contact for the switch {switch}. The messenger will remind you before each deadline and raise alarms during the 24 h grace. Please confirm that this address may receive them.
reminder_subject: Your dead-man-switch deadline is in {days} days
reminder_text: Your switch {switch} reaches its deadline on {deadline}. If you check in before then, nothing opens. Check in now:
reminder_drill_subject: Your fire drill reaches its deadline at {deadline}
reminder_drill_text: The fire drill {switch} reaches its deadline at {deadline}. Check in now, or let it run to see the letters open:
alarm_text: The deadline of your switch {switch} has passed. Your letters open in {hours} hours. Check in now:
release_subject: {sender}'s letter for you can now be opened
release_text: {sender}'s letter for you can now be opened.
release_steps:
1. Download the vault.
2. Open it in a browser, or drop it on the open page.
3. Follow the screen.
report_subject: Your letters were released: delivery report
report_text: Your switch {switch} was released. Emails sent to recipients: {sent}. Recipients without an email: {skipped}.
cancelled_text: The switch {switch} was cancelled. The messenger has deleted its data.
page_confirm_text: Thank you. This address may receive the email with the link if the letter is ever released.
page_stop_text: You will get no more emails about this switch.
page_stop_question: Do you want no emails from the messenger at all, for any switch?
page_never_text: This address will never be contacted again by the messenger.
page_invalid_text: This link is unknown or no longer valid.
report_line_not_sent: {index}. {name}: no email (address not confirmed, stopped, or unreachable)
